description: SERVICIO DE CONECTIVIDAD A INTERNET EN INSTITUCIONES EDUCATIVAS DEL DEPARTAMENTO NORTE DE SANTANDER is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Gobernación de Norte de Santander, Norte de Santander. En este data set se relacionan las Instituciones Educativas beneficiadas de la prestación del servicio de conectividad a internet en el Departamento Norte de Santander, como medio para fortalecer las competencias de los estudiantes en el uso de las TIC. Coverage: Gobernación de Norte de Santander, Norte de Santander. The portal files it under the publisher Gobernación de Norte de Santander, Norte de Santander. Its tags are internet, wi fi, servicio de conectividad, educación, conectividad. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Educación. The portal shows 2022-06-16 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
